name: Copy a team template to this project
description: Copy a team template to this project Creates a new team-scoped template in the **target** project (URL) from a **team-scoped** source template in the same organization. POST /api/projects/{project_id}/dashboard_templates/copy_between_projects/
context:
POST /api/projects/{project_id}/dashboard_templates/copy_between_projects/
Creates a new team-scoped template in the **target** project (URL) from a **team-scoped** source template in the same organization. Global and feature-flag templates return 400. Cross-organization or inaccessible sources return 404. Source and destination projects must differ (400 if equal). Conflicting `template_name` values on the destination are auto-suffixed with `(copy)`, `(copy 2)`, …
Required: project_id (path) — Project ID of the project you're trying to access. To find the ID of the project, make a call to /api/projects/.; body (body)

name: dashboard_templates_list
context:
GET /api/projects/{project_id}/dashboard_templates/
dashboard_templates_list
Required: project_id (path) — Project ID of the project you're trying to access. To find the ID of the project, make a call to /api/projects/.
Optional: is_featured (query) — Omit for all templates. When set, filter by featured flag; parsed with str_to_bool (same as other API query booleans).; limit (query) — Number of results to return per page.; offset (query) — The initial index from which to return the results.; ordering (query) — Optional. When not using `search`, results are sorted with featured templates first (`is_featured=true`), then by `template_name` (case-insensitive A–Z; `-template_name` for Z–A) or by `created_at` (`-created_at` for newest first). When `search` is set, order is featured first, then relevance rank, then case-insensitive name for ties.; scope (query) — Optional. `global`: official templates only. `team`: this project's saved templates only (`scope=team` rows for the current project). `organization`: templates shared across all projects in this organization. `feature_flag`: feature-flag dashboard templates only. Omit for official, organization, and this project's templates (default dashboard template picker behavior).; search (query) — Optional. Full-text search across template name, tags, and description, ranked by relevance. Use it to find templates for a topic (e.g. `retention`, `revenue`, `product analytics`).
